lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我昨天忘了给你打电话。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wàng le gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: I forgot to call you yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ yě hěn máng.
lines.en: It's fine, I was busy too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 真的对不起，我应该早点儿说。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de duìbuqǐ, wǒ yīnggāi zǎo diǎnr shuō.
lines.en: I am really sorry, I should have said so earlier.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 别放在心里，我们不用说这个。
lines.pinyin: Bié fàng zài xīnli, wǒmen bú yòng shuō zhège.
lines.en: Don't worry about it, we don't need to talk about this.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shì péngyou, zhè hěn zhèngcháng.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xià cì wǒ yídìng bú huì wàng.
lines.en: I definitely won't forget next time.
